report_title: Sphere Brawl: Rolling Rampage — Arena Tile Material Correction & Final Validation Report

executed_on_files.test_name: OBJ Syntax, Face Indices, Object Subparts & Material References
executed_on_files.method: Independent Python line-by-line parser (`parse_and_validate_obj`) across all 13 `.obj` files (1 shared base + 6 overlays + 6 complete states)
executed_on_files.actual_result: 0 syntax errors; 0 out-of-range `v`/`vt`/`vn` indices; 100% of faces have valid `v/vt/vn` triples, extended `v x y z r g b` vertex colors, and `o <Asset>__<Material>` object grouping.

executed_on_files.test_name: MTL References, RGB Definitions (`Kd`/`Ke`) & Atlas `map_Kd` Links
executed_on_files.method: Cross-checked every `.obj` `mtllib` and `usemtl` slot against its `.mtl` file and verified `Kd`/`Ke` RGB against the 9 approved palette entries (`parse_and_validate_mtl`)
executed_on_files.actual_result: 13/13 `.obj` files resolve their local `.mtl`; max `Kd`/`Ke` deviation from approved RGB is < 0.0001; all 9 materials include `map_Kd SphereBrawl_ArenaTile_PaletteAtlas.png`.

executed_on_files.test_name: GLB Structural Validity, Multi-Node Split, `COLOR_0` & Base-Colour Values
executed_on_files.method: Parsed 12-byte GLB header + JSON + BIN chunks across all 13 `.glb` files (`parse_and_validate_glb`), checking child `Part_*` nodes, `baseColorFactor`, `emissiveFactor`, `COLOR_0`, `TEXCOORD_0`, and embedded PNG
executed_on_files.actual_result: 13/13 `.glb` files valid; each complete state exports 4 child nodes (`Part_MAT_DarkNeutral`, `Part_MAT_AltNeutral`, `Part_MAT_LightTrim`, `Part_EMI_*`), exact `baseColorFactor`/`emissiveFactor`, `COLOR_0` vertex colors, and embedded 96x96 PNG atlas.

executed_on_files.test_name: Dimensions, Centered Origins, +Y Up Orientation & 0.2-Stud Grid Gap
executed_on_files.method: Measured bounding boxes, centers, top surface elevation (`Y = +1.00`), and 12.0-stud grid spacing across all 13 `.obj` and 13 `.glb` files
executed_on_files.actual_result: All 6 complete tiles & shared base measure exactly 11.8000 x 2.0000 x 11.8000 studs centered at `(0,0,0)` (`[-5.90,+5.90]` X/Z, `[-1.00,+1.00]` Y -> `World Y=51.0` when centered at `Y=50.0`), leaving an exact 0.2000-stud gap on a 12.0000-stud pitch.

executed_on_files.test_name: Triangle Counts Below 250 Budget Across All 6 Complete States
executed_on_files.method: Counted triangles in both `.obj` and `.glb` for SharedBase (84 tris), 6 Overlays (128–150 tris), and 6 Complete States
executed_on_files.actual_result: State 1 = 214, State 2 = 224, State 3 = 214, State 4 = 230, State 5 = 212, State 6 = 234 tris. All 6 complete states are strictly < 250 triangles (100% match between `.obj` and `.glb`).

executed_on_files.test_name: Degenerate Faces, Face Winding & Outward Normals
executed_on_files.method: Computed cross-product triangle area `0.5 * ||(p1-p0) x (p2-p0)||` and `dot(n_geom, vn)` across all 2,248 triangles in all 13 meshes
executed_on_files.actual_result: 0 degenerate triangles (min triangle area = 0.006897 sq. studs > 1e-7); 0 face-winding / normal mismatches (`dot(n_geom, vn) == 1.0` on all faces).

executed_on_files.test_name: Deterministic Generator Reproducibility (Python & Blender Collector Parity)
executed_on_files.method: Re-ran `generate_arena_tiles_pipeline.py` to `/tmp/det_test_dir` and compared SHA-256 hashes of `.obj`, `.mtl`, and `.glb`; also compared triangle & material groups against `generate_arena_tiles_blender.py`'s `DeterministicGeometryCollector`
executed_on_files.actual_result: 100% identical SHA-256 hashes across repeated runs; `generate_arena_tiles_blender.py`'s standalone procedural collector produces the exact same 84 base tris and 128–150 overlay tris per state.

executed_on_files.test_name: Preview Image Readability (Material-Colour, Neutral Clay, Side, Wireframe, Top)
executed_on_files.method: PIL `Image.verify()` + resolution/contrast audit (`validate_preview_png`) + visual inspection of all 12 PNG sheets (6 per-state 4-panel sheets + 6 master comparison sheets)
executed_on_files.actual_result: 12/12 PNGs decoded cleanly (2400x1440 to 3000x1725 px, pixel std 28.4–47.2); neutral clay geometry sheet and material-colour sheets are crisp and distinguishable at small gameplay scale.

executed_on_files.method: Verified `zipfile.ZipFile.testzip()` CRC-32 check and bidirectional path, byte-size, and SHA-256 parity between `MANIFEST.json` and the final ZIP archive
executed_on_files.actual_result: 0 corrupted ZIP entries; 100% match across all 62 files (23,149,688 bytes uncompressed, 20,162,724 bytes compressed).

requires_blender_or_roblox_studio.method: Checked Linux container for `blender` executable and `bpy` module; verified standalone `DeterministicGeometryCollector` in Python
requires_blender_or_roblox_studio.actual_result: Blender / `bpy` is not installed in this container. `generate_arena_tiles_blender.py` is self-contained and syntax/collector-verified in Python, but running its `bpy` FBX/GLB export requires a workstation with Blender 3.x/4.x.

requires_blender_or_roblox_studio.test_name: Roblox Studio 3D Importer Live Verification of Multi-Node GLB/OBJ & Material Setup
requires_blender_or_roblox_studio.method: Requires interactive Roblox Studio 3D Importer (`Import As Model = true`, `Merge Meshes = false`) and viewport inspection
requires_blender_or_roblox_studio.actual_result: Not executed in this headless sandbox. After importing in Roblox Studio, verify that the 4 child `MeshPart`s (`Part_MAT_*`, `Part_EMI_*`) appear under the root `Model` and apply `Enum.Material.Metal` / `Enum.Material.Neon` + `Color3` per `docs/README_Arena_Tile_Collection.md`.

requires_blender_or_roblox_studio.test_name: Optional Luau Helper (`Roblox_ArenaTile_Integration.lua`) Live Studio Execution
requires_blender_or_roblox_studio.method: Static audit of `ApplyApprovedMaterialsToImportedModel` and `MeasureVisualBounds` (no Roblox Studio runtime in sandbox)
requires_blender_or_roblox_studio.actual_result: Reviewed statically: assigns `Color3` and `Metal`/`Neon` to `Part_*` children without resizing meshes or mutating the authoritative `12x2x12` collider. Live execution requires Roblox Studio.
